candidate_root_changes: PML4[288] PMM-derived sparse supervisor direct map
layout.candidate_root_inheritance: all other PML4 entries exactly equal the retained PKMAP2 root

table_policy.manifest_authority: PKPMM7 reconstructs every free extent plus active non-release-excluded allocation and revalidates the exact manifest after table allocation
table_policy.coverage: every PMM-admitted page in the selector-10 lifecycle and no unowned, held, firmware, device, loader-retained, metadata-retained, or ACPI-snapshot-retained page
table_policy.sparse_topology: one leaf table per occupied 2 MiB physical region and one directory table per occupied 1 GiB region, bounded by the development-profile maxima
table_policy.table_frames: one contiguous DMA32 generation-owned PKPMM7 allocation sized from the manifest topology
table_policy.data_frames: one contiguous following DMA32 generation-owned PKPMM7 page
table_policy.physical_address_width: live BSP CPUID leaf 0x80000008 constrained to 36..52 bits
table_policy.materialization: volatile writes through one PKMAP2 bootstrap temporary leaf with translation readback and per-transition INVLPG
table_policy.retained_mappings: kernel image, exact guarded stack, and immutable handoff inherited and independently walked before activation
table_policy.temporary_alias: shared inherited PKMAP2 leaf revoked and translation-checked immediately before activation
table_policy.direct_map_permissions: supervisor writable NX write-back 4 KiB leaves for every manifest-admitted page
table_policy.cache_alias_policy: PWT or PCD on any audited direct leaf is rejected; inherited retained aliases are excluded from direct-map coverage
table_policy.user_initial_permissions: user writable NX write-back 4 KiB leaf

transaction_policy.cr3_precondition: IF clear, BSP id 0, exact retained original CR3
transaction_policy.activation: write candidate CR3 and require exact readback
transaction_policy.activation_failure: write exact original CR3 and require exact rollback readback
transaction_policy.active_table_access: only through candidate direct-map virtual addresses
transaction_policy.architectural_accessed_dirty_bits: admitted as the only hardware-mutated leaf bits and preserved across protect
transaction_policy.protect_receipt: local INVLPG after exact user RW/NX to RX commit
transaction_policy.user_unmap_receipt: local INVLPG after exact user leaf revocation
transaction_policy.direct_unmap_receipt: local INVLPG after exact data direct-alias revocation
transaction_policy.frame_reuse: forbidden until user and direct unmap receipts bind root generation, BSP id, sequence, and virtual address
transaction_policy.generation_retirement: restoring the original root mints one exact root-generation/BSP/local-context-flush receipt only for the one-processor profile
transaction_policy.future_smp_dependency: any active-processor count other than one is rejected as ShootdownRequired; no remote shootdown is executed or claimed
transaction_policy.release: table reclamation requires the exact retirement receipt, zero remote dependencies, inactive readback, complete table scrub, temporary-alias revocation, and PMM generation release

protected_assets: single cache policy per mapped frame
rejected_inputs: incompatible PWT or PCD cache alias
present temporary alias at activation boundary
unexpected PTE bits other than Accessed/Dirty
stale, absent, or reordered invalidation/retirement receipt
fault_controls: activation readback mismatch with exact rollback
active PTE write failure with exact rollback and no receipt
wrong root, CPU, and interrupt state rejection
missing and stale generation-retirement receipt rejection
trusted_for_this_profile: validated PKENTRY1 and PKMAP2 retained mappings
architectural MOV CR3 and INVLPG semantics

non_claims: PKVM3 maps every page admitted by the selector-10 PKPMM7 lifecycle; Boot Services and ACPI reclaim classes not admitted in that lifecycle remain unmapped.
PKVM3 excludes release-retained ownership generically and host-proves a sparse retained hole, but selector 10 does not execute the separate PKACPI1 snapshot/reclaim profile.
The four-directory and 512-leaf-table maxima bound the one-host qemu64 development profile; they are not a target-hardware capacity claim.
One local CR3 context flush and three INVLPG receipts are not an inter-processor shootdown protocol and do not prove SMP TLB coherence.
No ring 3 transition, syscall, PCID, global-page policy, huge page, COW, user-fault delivery, stack growth, pager, heap, MMIO/PAT/MTRR, pressure, or OOM path is implemented.
The active profile is unsigned qemu64 development evidence and grants no authority or actions.
No target hardware, second host, N9 exit, release, or production claim is made.
